# Luanda OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

Municipality outreach package for **Luanda, Angola**. Figures are
screening outputs for discussion, not a bid, endorsement or construction release.

## Audience

- Office of the Mayor or city executive for Luanda
- Luanda municipal transport and urban-planning authority
- Luanda climate, energy or sustainability office
- Luanda municipal finance and investment unit

## Local proposition

| Measure | Current planning result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 9,085,000 |
| Lines / route length | 9 / 390.4 km |
| Line-platform stops / fleet | 127 / 622 trainsets |
| Practical capacity ceiling | 2,276,640 passenger-trips/day |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 38.3 MW / 262.0 MWh |
| City programme CAPEX | $4.06 B |
| Local capital and value share | $2.95 B (73%) |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $6.20 B |
| Annual OPEX planning value | $101 M |

Lead with locally buildable infrastructure, open design review, renewable-energy
integration and a staged feasibility process. Do not lead with the comparator;
it is an illustrative sensitivity, not a vendor quotation.

## Call to action

Ask for a 30-minute technical review, nomination of a municipal counterpart,
access to current mobility/land/utility data, and agreement on the scope of an
independent feasibility study. Verify the recipient in
[`contact-research.csv`](../../../../contact-research.csv)
before sending.
